tw-wi-beaver-mattrick-farm-1925.st: Her lawyers said she confessed that more than $5,000 remained buried about 20 feet west of a small birch tree, some 30 paces to the left of where the recovered $3,000 had been dug up. On 25 Apr 1925 twenty-two men dug by lantern under guard and found nothing; no later find was reported.
